groups.saying_opens: كانت المرأة إذا توفي عنها زوجها

notes: Two sayings: Umm Salama's report of the Prophet's ruling on mourning (saying 1); Humayd's question to Zaynab and her answer about the custom (saying 2)
Saying 2 begins «قال حميد فقلت لزينب» with no earlier transmitter in this text; Malik's glosses («الحفش الخص») are left out
